summary: Iteration 29 — QRU Manufacturing Inspection System™ (MO-001 / P4). Deterministic quality gates thoroughly tested: 13/13 backend pytest cases pass; frontend /inspection dashboard renders all 4 stat cards, 3 filters, 127-row inspection table with correct filter counts (117 paused / 10 cleared), and detail modal shows all 9 gates plus Director Report for paused products. Gate enforcement via POST /api/automation/manufacture correctly returns 400 with 'Manufacturing paused by the Inspection System™' for thin/unverified KRs and 200 (order id) for cleared KRs. KR-00047 confirmed Cleared with score 100. Regression: /connectors and /evidence load and are functional.
critical_code_review_comments: inspection_system.inspect_kr_for_manufacture uses `dict((k,1) for k,_,_ in rows)` — works but a set literal `{k for k,_,_ in rows}` would be clearer/faster (nit).

GET /api/inspection/summary loads all products with `.to_list(500)` and inspects each on every request. For >500 products this silently truncates; consider pagination + light caching once product count grows.

Router file `/app/backend/routers/inspection.py` names its function `inspect_product` — same identifier as the imported `inspection_system.inspect_product` (aliased as `insp.inspect_product`), which is fine but a bit confusing. Rename to `product_detail` for clarity.
Verified that KR-00047 clears (score=100) and thin/unverified KRs pause with blocking_failures — gate wiring is correct.
